channel.title: Governor of West Virginia - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Governor of West Virginia (governor.wv.gov)

item.title: Governor Morrisey Notches More than a Dozen Legislative Wins in 2026 Legislative Session
item.description: CHARLESTON, W.Va. – Governor Patrick Morrisey today highlighted a series of major accomplishments secured by the Morrisey administration during the 2026 legislative session, delivering more than a dozen policy victories for West Virginians focused on tax relief, workforce development, government efficiency, energy policy, and education.

item.title: Governor Morrisey Highlights Road Investment, Education Freedom, and Tax Relief from 2026 Legislative Session
item.description: Governor Patrick Morrisey highlighted several major accomplishments secured during the 2026 legislative session, stronger infrastructure, emphasizing education freedom, and meaningful tax relief as key achievements made possible through responsible financial management.

item.title: Governor Morrisey Statement on the Expansion of Monarch Compute Campus
item.description: Governor Patrick Morrisey issued the following statement regarding the announcement that global AI infrastructure company Nscale has indicated that it will seek to acquire American Intelligence &amp; Power Corporation.

item.title: Governor Morrisey Establishes West Virginia–Ireland Education Alliance on St. Patrick’s Day
item.description: CHARLESTON, W.Va. – Governor Patrick Morrisey today signed House Bill 4087, establishing the West Virginia–Ireland Education Alliance to expand academic partnerships and strengthen ties between West Virginia and Ireland.

item.title: Governor Patrick Morrisey and First Lady Denise Morrisey Open Governor’s Mansion for Free Easter Tours
item.description: CHARLESTON, W.Va. – Governor Patrick Morrisey and First Lady Denise Morrisey have opened the Governor’s Mansion to the public for free Easter tours.

item.title: Governor Morrisey Announces Nearly $2 Million from Civil Contingency Fund to Complete New Taxiway at North Central West Virginia Airport
item.description: Governor Patrick Morrisey announced a nearly $2 million contribution from a federal matching appropriation in the Governor’s Civil Contingency Fund to support completion of a critical new taxiway project at the North Central West Virginia Airport in Bridgeport.

item.title: Governor Morrisey Announces 75 New Jobs and $81 Million Investment from Alcon Expansion
item.description: Charleston, W.Va. – Governor Patrick Morrisey today announced that Switzerland-based Alcon, a global leader in eye care, is significantly expanding its operations in Cabell County with an $81 million investment that is expected to create 75 new high-paying jobs.Watch the press conference here.

item.title: Governor Morrisey Announces Google Data Center Project in Putnam County
item.description: CHARLESTON, W.Va. - Governor Patrick Morrisey today announced that Google, one of the world’s most innovative tech companies, has purchased land in Putnam County and received approval for a multibillion-dollar High Impact Data Center Project. This marks an important step in West Virginia’s efforts to attract major investment, strengthen infrastructure, and compete for the jobs of the future.

item.title: Gov. Morrisey Welcomes the Launch of the 2026 Gold Rush Trout Stockings
item.description: Governor Patrick Morrisey marked the kickoff of the 2026 Gold Rush trout stockings, encouraging anglers from across the country to take part in one of West Virginia’s most popular outdoor traditions.

item.title: Governor Morrisey Signs Bill Authorizing New High School Athletics Transfer Rule
item.description: Governor Patrick Morrisey today applauded the West Virginia Secondary School Activities Commission (SSAC) for adopting a more flexible and balanced student-athlete transfer rule following the passage of House Bill 4425.

item.title: Governor Morrisey Celebrates West Virginia's Top Travel Award
item.description: Governor Patrick Morrisey, alongside the West Virginia Department of Tourism, today announced that the New River Gorge National Park & Preserve has been named a Best Underrated Travel Destination by U.S. News & World Report Magazine.

item.title: Gov. Morrisey Signs HB 4965 to Expand Patient Choice

item.title: Governor Morrisey Signs $230 Million Worth of Tax Cuts
item.description: Governor Patrick Morrisey today signed legislation to deliver a five percent across-the-board personal income tax cut for every West Virginia taxpayer.

item.title: Governor Morrisey Announces Amazon Expansion Bringing Jobs, Faster Delivery to West Virginia
item.description: Governor Patrick Morrisey joined local leaders and community partners to celebrate the opening of Amazon’s first operations facilities in Davisville and Beaver, bringing new jobs and faster delivery times to communities across the state.

item.title: March FY2026 General Revenue Report Shows Continued Strength, Signals Confidence in Year-End Surplus
item.description: Governor Patrick Morrisey announced that West Virginia’s March FY2026 General Revenue Fund collections once again exceeded expectations, reflecting continued economic strength and responsible financial management across the state.
